theorem lg_target {ι : Type u_1} {K : Type u_2} {M : Type u_3} [Field K] [AddCommGroup M] [_root_.Module K M] [Finite ι] [Infinite K] (f : ι → Module.Dual K M) (h : ∀ (i : ι), ∃ x, (f i) x ≠ 0) : ∃ x, ∀ (i : ι), (f i) x ≠ 0 := by
  let f' : ι → M → K := f
  let s : Set ι := Set.univ
  let v : ι → M := λ i, 0
  have hli : LinearIndepOn K v s :=
    by intro i j hne; rw [LinearIndepOn.def, hne]; intro h; rw [v]; exact zero_ne_zero.mp h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_eq_one K M f'
  use g
  intro i
  apply hg i
